title: Spec an Image from Requirements
prompt: A product card image renders at 300px on phones (100vw) and 300px inside a 3-column grid on desktop (30vw). Author the : srcset with at least three w-descriptor candidates (300w/600w/900w), a correct sizes attribute reflecting those two conditions, width="900" height="600", alt, and decoding="async". Then add a below-the-fold illustration img with loading="lazy" and its own alt.

tests.name: three w-descriptor candidates
tests.hint: w-descriptors are the real pixel widths of the files — 1x/2x/3x of a 300px slot.

tests.name: sizes reflects the layout
tests.hint: sizes is a media-condition list: phone case first, then the desktop slot width.

tests.name: intrinsic dimensions and alt
tests.hint: width/height describe the largest candidate's aspect ratio; the browser derives the box.

tests.name: lazy illustration, async decode
tests.hint: One hero eager, the rest lazy — and decoding="async" keeps decode work off the main thread.
